# Country scope = the empire opening the Voice Chat menu (from proxychat.40's immediate).
# Copies each player empire it has communications with into event targets
# proxychat_c1, proxychat_c2... in id order, and counts them in proxychat_contact_count.
proxychat_collect_contacts = {
	set_variable = { which = proxychat_contact_count value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = event_target:proxychat_p1
			NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:proxychat_p1 }
			has_communications = event_target:proxychat_p1
			event_target:proxychat_p1 = { proxychat_is_player = yes }
		}
		change_variable = { which = proxychat_contact_count value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = proxychat_contact_count value = 1 } } event_target:proxychat_p1 = { save_event_target_as = proxychat_c1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = event_target:proxychat_p2
			NOT = { is_same_value = event_target:proxychat_p2 }
			has_communications = event_target:proxychat_p2
			event_target:proxychat_p2 = { proxychat_is_player = yes }
		}
		change_variable = { which = proxychat_contact_count value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = proxychat_contact_count value = 1 } } event_target:proxychat_p2 = { save_event_target_as = proxychat_c1 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = proxychat_contact_count value = 2 } } event_target:proxychat_p2 = { save_event_target_as = proxychat_c2 } }
